verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents connecting banks, credit cards, PayPal and Square so transactions are imported automatically, and it records and matches invoice payments on its own. Payroll appears only as Payroll AI collecting time data and running payroll, with no evidence that payroll activity posts to the ledger or that external payroll systems can be connected. Missing for 10: documented payroll-to-ledger sync or third-party payroll connections, independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic feed reliability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Connect QuickBooks to your bank, credit cards, PayPal, Square, and more1 and we’ll import your transactions for you.
When customers pay through QuickBooks invoices, we’ll record and match it for you.
Import all your PayPal transactions into QuickBooks Online
Your Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees and spots inconsistencies, allowing you to run payroll more efficiently.
